name: Do I need to go through probate to sell an inherited home for cash in Florida?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to go through probate to sell an inherited home for cash in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Florida, generally, yes, you will need to go through probate to legally transfer ownership of an inherited home, even if you plan to sell it for cash. Probate is the legal process that validates the will, settles the deceased's debts, and formally transfers assets to heirs. The specific type of probate required (e.g., formal administration, summary administration, or disposition without administration) depends on the estate's size and complexity. Navigating this can impact the sale timeline, so consulting with a real estate professional experienced with probate sales in Florida is advisable to understand your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, in Florida, probate is usually required to legally transfer ownership of an inherited home before selling it for cash. The type of probate depends on the estate's details.
